_comment: Copy the 'hooks' block into your project's .claude/settings.json. After every Edit/Write/MultiEdit, the harness grounding gate runs on the changed .py/.go file; if it references a symbol that doesn't exist (or wrong call arity), the finding is fed back to the agent (exit 2) so it self-corrects before moving on. Requires `harness` on PATH (or use the full venv path to it).
